The task is to decide whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests any numbered claims from the claims dictionary.

The hypothesis is about a V04 flow rate versus a V06 stock rate spread over 6 months. It mentions "extending the 3-month version that showed positive IC", which is a prior result, but that isn't clearly any of the numbered claims. Claim 3 describes "momentum in one flow rate with wage-level momentum" and claim 7 describes an hours-versus-wage spread. Neither is the same as the V04/V06 spread. The hypothesis doesn't reference the claims' content directly, since it concerns a different construction and doesn't cite the migration report findings.

So uses_claim is false.
